Show HN: A proof-of-concept formalization of the IRS federal tax forms
stories.text:
The linked repo is 100% vibe coded, but it was built on a handful of principles:

- Most tax software derives trust from the party who maintains it (e.g. Intuit, the IRS, etc.)

- Vibe coded software lacks this trustworthiness.

- Therefore any formalization should build in verifiability and mechanisms that make it possible for users/maintainers to trace claims/interpretations back to authoritative source documents.

It's very much a back-burner passive project right now (do not use this for anything real!), but I feel strongly that something like this ought to exist for the public good. I built it to get a sense of what the shape of what such a thing might be.

DietPi v10.8 has been released
stories.text:
DietPi - the lightweight Debian based Linux distribution.

Our major changes:

DietPi-Wireguard: New tool to manage WireGuard servers and clients DietPi-Software: Software packages are setup via names instead of IDs HAProxy: Optimized installation (apt) without recompile needed DietPi-Config: Smaller improvements Quartz64: Support for ATAPI/SCSI CD/DVD/Blu-ray drives UTM VMs: Now with ARM and UEFI support DietPi-Network: Several improvements to our new network configuration tool Fixes for DietPi-Drive_Manager, DietPi-Cloudshell, UrBackup, Immich, Immich Machine Learning, Tor Relay, Kubo, Nextcloud

Of course, there are further changes and fixes. See also: https://dietpi.com/docs/releases/v10_8

How to update? Just run dietpi-update.

In addition, it would be nice, if you would contribute to our project or support us with a small donation: https://dietpi.com/contribute.html.
